headline: Sensex and Nifty Soar Ahead of Diwali Laxmi Pujan as Indian Markets Post Best Week in Six Years

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028 while Nifty reclaimed 25,000 as strong buying momentum continued.
A major rally across financial, auto, and IT sectors pushed Sensex up over 2,000 points earlier in the week.
Indian equities bucked global tech selloffs to post their best weekly performance in six years.
Stock market enters Samvat 2083 on a strong note with Nifty 50 holding firmly above the 25,000 level.
whatHappening: NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading today on the occasion of Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
Sensex surged past 81,000 and Nifty closed above 25,030 ahead of Samvat 2083.
Auto and bank indices led the D-Street rally with gains of up to 4 percent.
Peak XV and Y Combinator sold shares worth Rs 2,457 crore in Groww.
summary: Indian benchmark indices registered major gains ahead of Diwali, with Sensex reaching 81,028 and Nifty crossing 25,000. Rallies in financial, auto, and IT stocks helped D-Street post its best week in six years despite global market volatility. As Samvat 2083 begins today, NSE will conduct special Muhurat Trading on Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
